title: Area-Efficient Linear Regulator With Ultra-Fast Load Regulation
figure_number: Fig. 2. Proposed low-dropout linear regulator topology with replica-biased common-source unity-gain buffer.
function_summary: Area-Efficient Linear Regulator: For a 1.2-V 90 mVP-P output droop for a 100-mA load step with only a small and weight requirements and relatively small peak power of input voltage and 0.9-V output voltage the regulator enables a 1 W. on-chip decoupling capacitor of 0.6 nF.
